title: Book Two · Chapter 18: The Bird's Voice
story:
On Thursday, Leo opens his red book. A man sits under a tree. A bird is on a branch above him.

“Listen,” Leo says.

The man wants a quiet sleep. The bird wants to open a nut. It drops the nut on the man's head.

Leo gives the man a deep voice.

“Not here!”

Then he makes a tiny bird sound. Jun laughs at once. Mei looks up from her pencil case.

“Again,” she says.

Leo goes back to the man's words. This time the man sounds even more cross. Ronan looks at the picture and smiles.

He wants to read the next part. He puts one finger below the line. Leo is already there with his own finger.

“The man gives the bird his hat,” Leo reads. “Now the nut can fall into that.”

Ronan is still near the word gives. He moves his finger along. The next picture shows the bird inside the hat. It is asleep. The man is awake on the ground.

“The bird gets the bed,” Jun says.

Leo grins. He can read the short lines quickly and still find the joke. Ronan could read his own goat page yesterday. Today he cannot reach the end before Leo.

“Let me do it,” he says.

Leo gives him the book. Ronan starts at the man's first words. He tries the deep voice. It comes out too soft.

“What?” Jun asks.

Ronan makes it louder. He also says it faster. He joins the two words together.

“Not clear,” Mei says. “Try the man's line again.”

“I can read it.”

“I can't hear the words.”

Ronan looks at Leo. Leo is waiting with both hands off the book. No one is trying to take his turn away.

He starts the line again. He says the two words separately.

“Not. Here.”

Jun nods. Then Ronan makes the bird sound. It is low and rough. It sounds like a very tired cat.

Mei laughs. “Your bird needs water.”

“My bird needs a better reader,” Ronan says.

“Give it the hat,” Leo tells him.

Ronan puts one hand on top of his head. He makes the bird sound once more. This time all four children laugh, including him.

Miss Wu asks for quiet from the front. Another table is still reading. Leo closes his red book. The children lower their voices.

Ronan gives the book back. He wants to hear the joke again, but he also wants to read it as well as Leo.

At lunch, he asks to look at the page alone. Leo agrees after his meal. Ronan waits. He eats his rice and watches a patch of sun move across the table.

Then he takes the red book to a quiet seat. He reads about the man and the nut. The picture is still funny. He tries the deep voice once, very softly.

Jun passes with a cup of water.

“For your bird?” he asks.

“For your mouth,” Ronan says.

Jun takes a loud drink. Ronan laughs and gives Leo's book a careful look for wet marks. There are none. He closes it and carries it back to the desk.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

voice＝嗓音；nut＝坚果；again＝再一次；joke＝笑话。

## 理解问题

1. Leo怎样让大家听懂红书里的笑话？
2. Ronan后来怎样参加了这次阅读？

## 读句子

**Leo / opens / his red book.** Leo／打开／他的红色书。
